about_the_game:
Please note—as mentioned in the languages section, the DLC currently has no English translation! We’re working on it and will add it as soon as possible, but for now the episode is only available in Russian.

“For three years, Meinhardt Weiss has sailed the northern seas. No wonder—even on the oceans there is plenty of work for monster hunters.

As soon as our hero left his ship, he received a message. But not a letter from the Order of the Hunters. No, a messenger gave Herr Weiss an invitation to a ball at the manor of Katharina Freiin von Blumentrost.

“Freiin is known for her businesslike nature. I wonder if she has a job offer for me or if she misses me...”

The Sky Seekers Studio is proud to present a special episode dedicated to our favorite Kathrin, “The Ballad of Blood, Mist and Darkness”!

  • Immerse yourself in the dark atmosphere of medieval fantasy, where a horde of German folklore monsters await you—some you know and some you’ve never heard of!

  • Uncover the mystery of the connection between Maxim, Kathrin, and the mysterious heroes so similar to them;

  • A wealth of content awaits you inside—original art, new soundtracks, fresh images of your favorite characters! The approximate reading time of the episode will be at least 4-6 hours;

  • And in the end, maybe you’ll be able to find out who the Mask is and see what she can tell you in the future stories of Young Hearts!

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains mild sex scenes (without explicit erotic visuals), images of blood and violence, and colorful descriptions of physical suffering.

name: Young Hearts: “The Ballad of Blood, Mist, and Darkness”
short_description: An amazing fantastic story set in medieval Germany with characters suspiciously similar to Kathrin and Maxim. Only similar? And who on earth is the girl in the mask…?
